en-US.description: A lightweight Windows CRM for managing contacts, sales, and notes. It supports multiple address books, VCF import/export, and stores all data in a single SQLite file.
en-US.longDescription:
Vovsoft Customer Tracker is a lightweight CRM for Windows designed to help individuals and small businesses manage their client relationships and information efficiently.

Featuring a straightforward, user-friendly interface, the software allows you to maintain organized and detailed records for every client without the clutter of overly complex enterprise solutions.

Key Features:
* Multiple Address Books: Effortlessly manage different companies, projects, or distinct client bases within a single application. The software allows you to create and switch between multiple address books, keeping your different business ventures perfectly organized and separated.
* Single-File Database: All your CRM data is stored within a single SQLite file (customers.db). This streamlined approach to database management makes it incredibly easy to back up your records, transfer your data to a new computer, or archive past address books without needing to configure a complex SQL server.
* Portable Edition Available: For ultimate flexibility, a portable version of the software is available. You can run the application directly from a USB flash drive or any removable media without needing to install it.
* Comprehensive Contact Details: Store essential information including names, birthdays, addresses, organizations, multiple phone numbers, email addresses, and websites. You can even assign profile pictures to individual contacts.
* VCF Import and Export: Easily migrate your contact lists in and out of the application with full support for the standard vCard (.vcf) format.
* Sales Tracking: Switch over to the "Sales" tab to record customer transactions. You can log the specific amount, date and time, a brief description, and mark whether the invoice is paid or not-paid.
* Customer Notes: The dedicated "Notes" tab allows you to keep track of interactions, special requests, or important reminders by adding text notes alongside a datetime stamp.
* Intuitive Navigation: Quickly locate specific clients using the built-in search bar, jump to contacts using the A-Z alphabetical index sidebar, or filter by your selected company address book.
en-US.name: Vovsoft Customer Tracker
